definitions.explanation: The native Japanese counter for five objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{五|いつ}つ⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{五|いつ}つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{五|いつ}つ⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.english: There were five eggs in the box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五|いつ}つ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦ずつ→ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{答|こた}えて→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There are five questions, so please answer them one by one.

notes:
{五|いつ}つ is the native Japanese (やまとことば) number for five, used when counting general objects without a specific counter.

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧, ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧, ⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧, ⟦{四|よっ}つ→四つ：03039_yottsu⟧, {五|いつ}つ
- ⟦{六|むっ}つ→六つ：02974_muttsu⟧, ⟦{七|なな}つ→七つ：02926_nanatsu⟧, ⟦{八|やっ}つ→八つ：02979_yattsu⟧, ⟦{九|ここの}つ→九つ：02902_kokonotsu⟧, ⟦{十|とお}→十：28376_too⟧

USAGE:
- Used for counting general objects, abstract things, and when no specific counter applies; only goes up to 10 — beyond that, use Sino-Japanese numbers with appropriate counters
- Also used informally for age: {五|いつ}つ can mean "five years old" for young children, common in casual/family contexts
